recruiters.name: Anna Keller
recruiters.bio: Has placed analysts and managers at banks, funds and fintechs for over ten years.

chat.ask: I’ve applied to 80 analyst roles and heard nothing back. What am I doing wrong?
chat.answer: Your resume reads like a job description. Banks scan for deals and numbers, so lead every line with the result.
chat.followUp: Can you check my top three bullets?

recruiters.name: Daniel Reyes
recruiters.bio: Hires engineers and product people for startups and big tech alike.

chat.ask: I was laid off in March. How do I explain the gap?
chat.answer: One line is enough: “Role eliminated in a company-wide layoff.” Then show what you’ve built since. Side projects count.
chat.followUp: Should I mention it in my cover letter?

recruiters.name: Maria Lopez
recruiters.bio: Connects clinicians and healthcare operators with hospitals and health-tech teams.

chat.ask: I’m a nurse moving into health-tech. Will anyone take me seriously?
chat.answer: Yes, if you lead with the workflows you improved. Health-tech teams need people who know the floor.
chat.followUp: Which job titles should I search for?

recruiters.name: James Walker
recruiters.bio: Knows what hiring managers look for in sellers, marketers and growth leads.

chat.ask: I’ve reached the final round three times and then got ghosted. Why?
chat.answer: Usually it’s the close. Send a short 30-60-90 day plan after the last interview. It shows you’re already doing the job.
chat.followUp: What should go in that plan?

recruiters.name: Sofia Rossi
recruiters.bio: Helps consultants move between firms and into strategy roles in industry.

chat.ask: Recruiters say I’m “too consulting” for industry roles. What does that mean?
chat.answer: They can’t see what you owned. Pick two projects and write what changed because of you.
chat.followUp: How do I explain why I’m leaving?

recruiters.name: Omar Haddad
recruiters.bio: Recruits operations, logistics and supply-chain talent across manufacturing and retail.

chat.ask: I got an offer, but it’s 15% below my last salary. Should I take it?
chat.answer: Not yet. Ask for the range, then anchor on the savings you’ve delivered. Ops offers usually have room to move.
chat.followUp: How do I ask without losing the offer?
